name: @supacloud/compiler
description: Static compiler for @supacloud/app metadata: builds the application graph from AST, validates it, and generates reflection-free factory code

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.prepare:db: bun install --cwd ../contracts --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../contracts build && bun install --cwd ../db --force --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../db build && bun install --force --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts src/diagnostics.ts src/cli.ts src/delivery-bundle-worker.ts src/database-governance-worker.ts --outdir dist --target node --conditions=supacloud-source --external @typescript/typescript6 --external @supacloud/db --external @supacloud/db/source-contracts --external graphql --external '@graphql-codegen/*'
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run test:package
